faq.q: Does every listing on the Langley open-houses page hold an open house?
faq.a: Not on the evidence of the first page: five of the twelve cards carried an open-house time block and seven carried no open-house label or time at all in the page text, so treat an unlabelled card as a listing to confirm privately, not as an open house.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Langley Open?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Langley Open is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
